pages.text:
When your mana level reaches $(9)level 99$(), you'll find that mana growth has completely stagnated.

This is because you've hit a $(l)shackle$() — the boundary between ordinary life and legend. Ordinary mana training can no longer advance you further; you need a $(l)breakthrough$().

Breakthrough requires items related to legendary creatures, borrowing their power to shatter the bottleneck and complete a life-level leap.

pages.title: Dragon Egg Breakthrough
pages.text:
$(l)Usage:$()
At mana level 99, hold a $(9)Dragon Egg$() and right-click to trigger the breakthrough.

pages.title: Nether Star Breakthrough
pages.text:
$(l)Usage:$()
Same as the dragon egg — at level 99, hold a $(9)Nether Star$() and right-click.

$(l)What does level 100 mean?$()

First, after breaking through to level 100, your mana cap will increase significantly and you'll gain the ability to fly. The mana cap from levels 1-99 grows linearly, but from level 100 onward it $(9)doubles$() with each level — meaning that from level 100, your mana reserves will far exceed the sum of everything before.

Second, you'll gain the trait of $(9)damage cap$() — a single instance of regular damage dealt to you cannot exceed a certain value, no matter how high it should be. This trait is one of the key distinctions between legendary and ordinary beings. The trait is a derivative of rules, a gift the world presents to newly born legends.

Additionally, level 100 unlocks the $(l)Magic Star$() — a flying companion that can cast spells automatically. See the next page for details.
